_about: Problem families for app marketing (SKILL.md 'Repeating problems'). A ledger line that records a problem names its family in `problem` (from 2026-11-13T20:00Z, `marketing.mjs log` refuses one that does not). Older lines are mapped by `text`: case-insensitive patterns searched in a line's operation, reason, next and left_open; a line matching `not_text` is not this family's.

`history`: days the merged pull requests show the family, as 'YYYY-MM-DD <repo>#N: what', read from every PR in astrojams1/skills and astrojams1/app-sites on 2026-11-13. They count as days seen, never as a sighting after a fix.

`cause`: the root cause, from every line of the family. `fix`: the change that removes it, or the owner's step for a STANDING family. `marketing.mjs recurring` judges each family from the ledger and git.
`expected`: lines that record an outside wait or a decision, not a fault. They are not counted as problems; `recurring --unmapped` counts them apart.

families.title: Apple download totals counted a report instance or a date more than once
text: repeated in a later report instance
history: 2026-11-07 skills#147: an instance re-counted on every pull, Newsworthy 3 to 5
2026-11-12 skills#194: dates repeated across instances, Space Worms 22 (true 13)
2026-11-12 app-sites#48: recount appended corrected totals
families.cause: Apple's daily report instances repeat the last two or three dates and the newest replaces them; pull first re-read whole instances (1.4.1 fixed that), then added every instance's rows, so a date counted two or three times
families.fix: skills#194 (1.14.0): pull keeps each date once from the newest instance, pull --recount re-reads, and check fails a total that disagrees with its unique days

families.title: Site and page visits missing, incomplete or inflated by agent test loads
history: 2026-11-13 skills#221: no visit numbers at all (Vercel Analytics off)
2026-11-13 skills#222: products with no visit got no line
2026-11-13 skills#227: 8 untagged agent test loads counted
2026-11-13 skills#231: experiment pages not counted per page
families.cause: the first-party counter counted every load: an agent verifying a page in headless Chromium was counted as a real visitor unless someone tagged the URL or wrote the load into visits-excluded.jsonl by hand, and the read first left out products and pages with no line
families.fix: skills#222, skills#227 and skills#231: every product and experiment page gets a line, and agent loads are tagged or written to visits-excluded.jsonl and subtracted; app-sites also stops the beacon in any browser driven by automation (navigator.webdriver)

families.title: A download cannot be tied to the channel that brought it
history: 2026-11-09 app-sites#28: campaign token deferred, App Store Connect not signed in
2026-11-12 skills#194: no API access to the campaign token
2026-11-12 skills#197: no download attributable to app-marketing
2026-11-13 skills#221: visit tags count site visits only
families.cause: App Store campaign links need the provider token (pt=), which App Store Connect shows only to a signed-in user and no API key can read, so storeLink adds no pt= or ct= and every download is known only by Apple's source type (search, browse, web referrer); two web products have no visit counter
families.fix: owner only: read the two provider tokens once in App Store Connect; every store link the sites emit then carries pt= and a per-placement ct= (catalog.ts storeLink), checked by the app-sites tests

families.title: Work done for a product not on sale or taken out of marketing
history: 2026-11-12 skills#198: Giraffe Stretch coming-soon Shorts made and scheduled
2026-11-12 app-sites#58: Giraffe Stretch Short held
2026-11-13 skills#232: 4 Giraffe Stretch items done
2026-11-13 app-sites#104: Giraffe Stretch leaf-letters experiment page shipped
2026-11-13 app-sites#111: World Sim, Clawgree, Eggaduppa, Universe of Sound taken out; 38 unsent firsts dropped
families.cause: the stage gate was added channel by channel (Shorts in skills#198, items in skills#232, email in app-sites#111) and nothing checked what was already built, so an experiment page and experiment entries stayed live for products that are not, and the sender treated an app with no profile (Pipsqueak) as live
families.fix: the sender treats an app with no profile as not cleared; check fails an experiment on a non-live profile without a retire verdict; the Giraffe Stretch leaf-letters page is taken down and the out-of-marketing experiments are retired

families.title: A Short went up without its pinned comment, Related video, tags, a right title or description
history: 2026-11-12 skills#189: made-for-kids flag not always set
2026-11-12 skills#193: descriptions without the search phrase; pinning judged not operable
2026-11-12 skills#202: titles hid the app name past 40 characters
2026-11-13 skills#226: LOB description said App Store
2026-11-13 skills#237: 28 Shorts lacked tags, pinned comments and Related videos
families.cause: the YouTube Data API cannot pin a comment or set a Related video, so runs skipped both as 'not operable' although the Mac's Chrome is signed in to YouTube Studio, and nothing checked a public Short's fields
families.fix: skills#237: comment and Related video set on every Short through Studio on the Mac, and shorts.mjs due lists any public Short missing a pinned comment or Related video

families.title: A Short sends viewers to a search that does not find the app first
text: does not list (?:it|the app) in its first
history: 2026-11-12 skills#193: descriptions lacked the search phrase
2026-11-13 app-sites#108: LOB phrase found other games
families.cause: Shorts links do not click, so a Short gives a search phrase, and the phrase was written without checking what the store or web search returns for it
families.fix: skills#194 records a checked searchPhrase in every profile and a daily search-phrase item; skills#226 ends a web product's Short on its address

families.title: Shorts made, then failed review or were pulled by the owner
history: 2026-11-12 skills#174: 9 template Shorts pulled
2026-11-12 skills#176: owner rejected remakes that passed every check
2026-11-12 skills#184: owner rejected 5 scheduled remakes
2026-11-12 skills#210: a reviewer invented a rule

families.fix: skills#237: one-page Shorts guidelines from research, each with its source and test status, that makers and panels check against

families.title: A Short could not be recorded because the simulator refuses a scheduled session
text: blocked in this scheduled pass by the same refusal
history: 2026-11-10 skills#161: the iOS Simulator tool refused the scheduled session; fallbacks added
families.cause: the iOS Simulator tool refuses scheduled sessions, and native apps had no other way to drive the app for a take
families.fix: skills#161: recording.md's 'When the Simulator tool refuses' route: the app's own XCTest UI test (ShortsTakes) or its web build drives the take, so no step needs the Simulator tool (Füd's test merged in wendigo124/FSRN_Subs#185)

families.title: The cloud run reports that it cannot read Apple's download numbers
text: No Apple download data in the cloud
no new Apple numbers in the cloud
families.cause: Apple's analytics key is in 1Password, which only the Mac reaches; the Mac already pulls the numbers into metrics.jsonl, but the cloud's measure step said so each morning instead of reading them
families.fix: SKILL.md Measure: the cloud reads the Mac's newest downloads lines from metrics.jsonl with their date and never logs that it cannot read Apple

families.title: An unattended session's permission check refused a send, a push or a scheduled task
history: 2026-11-12 skills#191: Vegas Microworks task had no permission mode and sat 48 minutes
2026-11-12 skills#195: the Show HN task stalled the same way
2026-11-12 skills#200: the cloud refused the call that sends pitches
families.cause: unattended sessions refuse acts their safety check classes as real-world (sending mail, pushing to a repository not attached with push access, creating a task), and separate scheduled tasks without a permission mode stall on their first prompt
families.fix: skills#200: a merge starts the app-sites Pitches workflow, which sends, so no run calls the sender; skills#195 runs the side jobs inside the Mac pass; a repository is attached with push access before a push

families.title: The cloud has no GitHub token, so a read of the pitch sender or visit counter answered 401
history: 2026-11-12 skills#200: pitches got 401 without a token
families.cause: the sender's detail and the counter accepted only a GitHub token as proof of access, and cloud runs have none
families.fix: skills#200: the caller proves access with the deployed queue's digest from its own clone

families.title: App Store search pages rate-limited a check
text: crashed on the first App Store 429
history: 2026-11-12 skills#202: shorts.mjs phrase crashed on an App Store 429
2026-11-13 skills#215: after a 429 phrase fell back to a weaker phrase
families.cause: Apple's search page answers 429 to quick repeat reads, and phrase first crashed, then took the next phrase as an answer
families.fix: skills#215: phrase waits out a 429 or 503 and never treats a refused read as a result

families.title: Too many helpers at once on the Mac
history: 2026-11-13 skills#227: about 11 subagents and 4 renders at once
families.cause: two-deep helpers multiply: a carried job's makers and their review panels each started their own
families.fix: skills#227: at most three subagents alive at once, nested ones included, and one heavy job

families.title: An experiment without a measure, a judge date or a verdict
history: 2026-11-12 skills#209: listing tests queued for an unknown next version
2026-11-13 skills#219: Invent makes every experiment carry a measure and judge date
2026-11-13 skills#231: experiment pages had no per-page measure
families.cause: experiments were shipped as pages without a dated judgement, so nothing came due
families.fix: skills#219: check refuses an experiment without shipped and judge dates and next lists judge-<id> when it is due; skills#231 measures each page

families.title: log took a line that check then failed, or a correction could not clear a wrong line
history: 2026-11-05 skills#133: a finding wrongly finished an item
2026-11-12 skills#204: an end missing left_open could not be corrected
2026-11-13 skills#223: log took an unknown app that check failed
families.cause: log and check applied different rules, so log accepted lines check later failed (an unknown app, a correction naming no line) and the build broke
families.fix: log runs every per-line rule check runs, the correction rule and the problem-family rules included, so a line log takes passes check

families.title: A run left known work undone: a budget, a throttle or 'not reached'
text: were not built in this run
needs a UI-test or simulator recording route
history: 2026-11-08 skills#158: runs capped at 2 or 3 items
2026-11-10 skills#161: a stale prompt cap held the Mac pass to 3 items
2026-11-10 skills#162: hidden throttles
2026-11-12 skills#194: end refused while work remains
families.cause: runs treated a budget in a prompt, a throttle in a file or the end of the session as a reason to stop, and the end check knew only the words 'not reached'
families.fix: end refuses any undone-work wording (not built, not made, not written, not sent, left for the next run) without a blocker, as well as 'not reached'

families.title: A task prompt or a discovery copy of a skill fell behind the skill
history: 2026-11-08 skills#159: the routine prompt restated the skill
2026-11-10 skills#161: the Mac pass prompt kept a cap
2026-11-12 skills#191: a task read a copy stuck at 1.0.0
2026-11-12 skills#206: pitches.md discovery copy stale
2026-11-13 skills#233: .claude and .agents copies behind #224 to #232
families.cause: the repository's .claude/skills and .agents/skills copies are refreshed by hand with manage.sh link, and nothing failed when a skill changed without them
families.fix: a test fails when a discovery copy differs from its skill, so every skill change ships its copies

families.title: A run waited on the owner's go-ahead, sign-in or OK
text: holds store listing changes for the owner
history: 2026-11-07 skills#142: Nametag Shorts parked for a go-ahead
2026-11-07 skills#145: a draft PR asked the owner about keywords
2026-11-12 skills#197: a postal address asked for again
2026-11-12 skills#194: the autonomy rule
families.cause: the owner-only check in log applied only to action lines and left_open, so a finding could still be left deferred on the owner or stage a change for his go-ahead
families.fix: log refuses blocked_by owner and go-ahead wording on any line after 2026-11-12 18:00Z; owner-only work is dropped and routed around

families.title: A featuring nomination deferred day after day because no dated update exists
families.cause: the featuring item came due by the calendar, so each Mac pass found no dated update and logged a deferral; nothing to nominate is not a blocker
families.fix: the featuring items' how: with no version in preparation dated 21 or more days out, log ok 'no dated update to nominate'; the item comes back daily

families.title: An app went live and had no marketing profile for a day or more
history: 2026-11-12 app-sites#44: Hanzi Cards and Data Center live with no profiles
families.cause: profiles were written only when a run happened to compare store.json with marketing/apps, so a new app waited a day for its profile and its Apple analytics request, and its first numbers came later still
families.fix: next lists <app>/profile for every live store.json app with no profile, on the cloud runner, the day it goes live

families.title: Gmail limited or refused the owner's mailbox
history: 2026-11-12 app-sites#54: no Gmail limit handling
2026-11-12 app-sites#64: bursts of 13 to 21 a minute
2026-11-12 app-sites#66: Vegas Microworks mail missing from the ceiling
2026-11-13 app-sites#78: a rate error answered 500
2026-11-13 app-sites#115: 429 Mail sending at 549 sent in 24 hours
families.cause: the sender counted only its own cold mail on a calendar day while the mailbox also sent replies, other senders' mail and Vegas Microworks mail, so Gmail's rolling limit was reached
families.fix: app-sites#115: one rolling 24-hour budget read from Gmail's own sent count, and a stand-down until Gmail's retry time on a 429 Mail sending

families.title: Merged pitches not sent, or a send stuck
history: 2026-11-12 app-sites#54: only 17 of 22 sent
2026-11-12 app-sites#56: a stuck sending row
families.cause: sending depended on a run calling the sender, which the cloud refused, and a send cut off mid-way stayed in sending
families.fix: app-sites#54: a merge starts the Pitches workflow, which sends; app-sites#56: a send stuck ten minutes is retried

families.title: A pitch's source page refused the sender (bot challenge), so the pitch failed
history: 2026-11-12 app-sites#54: 3 fetch failures, a Cloudflare 403
2026-11-12 app-sites#57: a replacement page hit the same challenge
2026-11-13 app-sites#74: a bot challenge, dropped
families.cause: pitches were queued citing source pages behind bot challenges; the sender rightly never passes one, and nothing checked the page before the merge
families.fix: pitches-preflight fetches every new unsent pitch's source page as the sender does before the merge, and the run replaces or drops one that is refused

families.title: A pitch reply missed, or an automatic reply counted as a person
history: 2026-11-12 app-sites#61: replies in a new conversation never seen
2026-11-13 app-sites#76: an auto-acknowledgement recorded by hand
2026-11-13 app-sites#82: the first 4 replies were canned mail
families.cause: reply search followed only the pitch's own thread, and every answer counted as a human reply
families.fix: app-sites#61 searches replies by sender; app-sites#82 classifies automatic replies (autoKind) and relabels them

families.title: A human reply to a pitch waited unanswered
history: 2026-11-13 skills#239: replies held behind a 20-email buffer
2026-11-13 app-sites#115: only 20 reserved for replies
families.cause: answers waited for the next scheduled run and behind the cold-mail ceiling
families.fix: app-sites#117 and skills#239: replies are never held by the ceiling, the workflow opens a Reply waiting issue that starts a reply pass at any hour

families.title: A first pitch bounced
history: 2026-11-12 app-sites#59: 1 bounce
2026-11-12 app-sites#64: 1 bounce
2026-11-13 app-sites#83: bounces at 3
families.cause: published addresses that no longer take mail: 5 of 175 first emails, 3 of them a named person's address on a publication page and 2 role addresses at sites whose page still shows them
families.fix: app-sites#67 and app-sites#78 refuse placeholders, typos, domains with no MX and sources that bounced; still open: the 2026-11-13 bounces came after them

families.title: Sent pitches are not labelled because the Gmail token lacks gmail.modify
history: 2026-11-13 app-sites#100: labels ship as no-scope
families.cause: the mailbox's Gmail token lacked gmail.modify when labelling shipped (app-sites#100), so labelling answered no-scope; the scope was granted later the same day outside the repository
families.fix: app-sites#100 labels with the mailbox's own token; the Pitches run at 2026-11-13T20:14Z reads labels ok, labelFailed 0

families.title: A connector failed during a run
history: 2026-11-13 app-sites#98: Neon connector down in the morning
families.cause: the Neon connector answered server errors for about two hours on 2026-11-13, an outage on its side
families.fix: the next run of the day reads it (it recovered at 15:33Z the same day); no change needed while it stays one day
